scope: Feeding evidence for plant-catalog species, read from open-access full texts or marked as leads. Observation and keeper-practice records only: never a feeding grade, safe-to-feed verdict, nutrient value or toxicity judgement. Linked to a catalog entry only when the reported name is an exact accepted GBIF species.

verification_levels.full_text_verified: the stated table or section of the original was read and names the plant with the finding
verification_levels.literature_lead_not_reverified: abstract only, or a repository summary whose original was not re-read
